name: The Fourth Horseman

frame.name: Thunderer
frame.description: This weapon's rate of fire is increased significantly, and fires full auto. Final blows auto load ammo from reserves. Powerful targets fully reload the weapon.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.description:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Broadside
perks.description: Each successive shot has more damage and more spread.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

flavor: It's not a holdout weapon; it's a pathfinder.

catalyst.name: The Fourth Horseman Catalyst
catalyst.description: Adds an additional round to the magazine and increases reload speed.
